classification_law: If semantics are fixed but serving is incomplete, classify as serving/integration debt rather than missing ontology.

serving_verdict.reasoning: Every retained objective prerequisite has a lawful, generic, immutable-ref-based serving carrier for all seven required dimensions. None of the seven dimensions requires a new semantic form for any objective prerequisite. What is unproved is population of those carriers at declared scope and the joined rebuild/replay proof across heterogeneous owners.
serving_verdict.explicit_non_diagnosis: The unresolved world->F8 semantic operation (residual H-D) is NOT classified here as serving debt. Its transport is implementable, but its meaning is not yet fixed, and per the audit's own law implementable transport does not make unresolved interpretation into serving debt.

cache_and_retirement_notes: Cache eviction must not become semantic erasure; cache must not restrict future lawful queryability.
PRE-V3 can retain raw roots; B5 disclaims source retirement, so no mandatory deletion or new retirement system is established.
Source-retirement equivalence remains a conditional form: if retirement is ever selected, a positive per-source injective-equivalence gate plus retained interpretation/replay obligations is required.

population_person_and_world_time_person_.population_noncollapse: POPULATION_FACT != POSITIONED_SUBJECT_POSSIBILITY != INDIVIDUAL_PREDICTION != V3_REALIZED_ACTOR_STATE; DEMOGRAPHIC_PROBABILITY != PERSONHOOD; POSITION_CONDITIONING != PERSONALITY_ESSENCE — all preserved in the serving layer as separate reference and permission classes.
population_person_and_world_time_person_.person_noncollapse: M3 RESULT_JURISDICTION=PRE_V3_OBJECTIVE_WORLD with PERSON_STATE_SEMANTICS=FORBIDDEN and a nine-role _PERSON_STATE_ROLES exclusion set; actor indexing limited to NO_ACTOR_INDEX or OBJECTIVE_ACTOR_INDEXED. Objective actor identifiers are not person state.
population_person_and_world_time_person_.world_time_person_history_noncollapse: A historical object is not automatically a valid current fact. Source observation time, modeled valid time and current selection must be distinguished by a coherent cross-owner snapshot. F2 may state that later realization requires repeated exposure, sequence, persistence, reinforcement, destabilization or transition history — as requirement refs, never as claims the history occurred. That is the exact boundary preserving world-time from person-history.
